decisions.reason: This healthcare and hospitality recruitment service remains a weak strategic fit with the firm's maritime-focused integrated solutions, so management would likely redeploy resources to core shipping and digital compliance offerings.
Superyacht crew recruitment is a credible adjacency to the firm's established crewing and training capabilities and can use much of the same network, processes and customer trust.
The maritime education programme fits the firm's workforce and training strengths, and the early expansion of the Smart Academy partner network suggests promising traction.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services are highly aligned with client needs and regulation, and the firm's successful delivery of all FuelEU monitoring plans before deadline indicates strong market relevance.
The emissions compliance dashboard supports the firm's digitalisation strategy, is integrated into its PAL ship management software, and complements its broader compliance service offering.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool fits the push toward transparent efficiency and environmental performance, though it has a slightly higher consolidation risk than core services if bundled deeper into the software suite.
